initial_application: No commit message was found that names FHIR-34063. The apparent application was 21db7ce85648ecbcc2a88295b74e4a4015053b22, which added MessageHeader.extensionv2Profile and its children directly to the active MessageHeader StructureDefinition. The same block was then removed by bc8ed97893913a99cbddc23ffbd05da2092673cc, whose subject is 'removed the V2Profile extension'.
additional_context: Core had already moved MessageHeader extension definitions out of the FHIR core checkout in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0. The FHIR Extension Pack currently contains MessageHeader extension definitions under input/definitions/MessageHeader, but searches found no v2Profile/MSH-21 extension there. Jira comments and OO minutes in December 2023 describe FHIR-34063 as a likely lost/found extension needing clarification, analogous to FHIR-31541, which was recovered through an Extension Pack pull request.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch and made no core source change. Re-adding the removed MessageHeader.extensionv2Profile backbone element would repeat the prior core misapplication, while the missing artifact belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack.
